src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_cd118_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 118th Congress's districts (its file says session 118).
rec: Carter Plan, 17 districts, adopted by the Pennsylvania Supreme Court's order of 2022-02-23 (Carter v. Chapman)

Supreme Court of Pennsylvania, Carter v. Chapman, Nos. 7 MM 2022 and 8 MM 2022: Justice Wecht's concurring opinion (decided 2022-02-23, opinion filed 2022-03-09) joining the adoption of the Carter Plan as the 2022 congressional plan
The legislature's bill (HB 2146) was vetoed and the court chose the plan proposed by the Carter petitioners (opinion filed 2022-03-09). The cd118 file has 17 districts.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2022 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2022 legislative session year.
rec: 2021 Legislative Reapportionment Commission Final Reapportionment Plan, 50 Senate districts, approved 4-1 and filed 2022-02-04
Pennsylvania Legislative Reapportionment Commission: February 4, 2022, the Commission adopts and files the 2021 Final Plans

The Pennsylvania Supreme Court found the plan lawful by a 7-0 order on 2022-03-16 and ordered it used in all forthcoming elections. The 2022 file differs from the 2020 file (73% raster agreement) and equals the 2024 file.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_sldl_500k
sldl.vint: The Census Bureau's 2022 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2022 legislative session year.
rec: 2021 Legislative Reapportionment Commission Final Reapportionment Plan, 203 House districts, approved 4-1 and filed 2022-02-04
Pennsylvania Legislative Reapportionment Commission: February 4, 2022, the Commission adopts and files the 2021 Final Plans
As the Senate entry. The 2022 file passes the county check (0 of 203 fail); the 2020 file fails 18.
